method.warmup: one initial fixture import before measured reloads
method.storageState: exact locally committed medium Project reopened on every iteration
method.rawSampleOrder: iteration order retained; no outlier deletion
method.heapSignal: Chromium performance.memory sampled from page-module baseline through scenario completion

limitations: The browser evidence API does not expose the active DevTools CPU multiplier; the constrained setting is supported by Project Owner confirmation and preserved target continuity.
DevTools CPU throttling is relative to the host and is not a claim about a specific mobile CPU architecture.
Chromium usedJSHeapSize is a process main-thread signal and excludes Worker, Canvas, and GPU allocation.
No forced garbage collection was available; the signed retained delta is preserved without clamping or reinterpretation.
This artifact does not measure import-Worker peak memory.
